2026-11-26.title: Blade Runner 2099
2026-11-26.overview: Fifty years after the events of Blade Runner 2049, Los Angeles has been reborn, just not by humanity. Cora, a fugitive in a final bid to stop running, takes on one last identity: a Blade Runner. Forced to partner with Olwen, a Replicant days from dying, she hunts down a runaway hiding a truth that could collapse their fragile city.

2026-11-26.title: The Remarried Empress
2026-11-26.overview: Beloved Empress Navier rules the Eastern Empire alongside Emperor Sovieshu. But when Sovieshu falls for a runaway slave and demands a divorce, Navier will agree on one condition: that she's given approval to remarry rival Prince Heinrey of the Western Kingdom.

2026-11-26.title: Bass X Machina
2026-11-26.overview: In a steampunk West overrun by outlaws, machines and supernatural forces, a father is forced to become judge, jury and executioner to protect his family.

2026-11-26.title: YAGA
2026-11-26.overview: While a private investigator probes the disappearance of the young heir to a powerful fishery, he finds himself at odds with an apprehensive local detective, a charismatic university professor with a taste for younger men, and a labyrinth of enigmatic suspects, secret lives, and ancient magic.

2026-11-26.title: VisionQuest
2026-11-26.overview: With a bounty on his head, Vision must confront his nature and resist Ultron's influence to survive.

2026-11-26.title: Avatar: Seven Havens
2026-11-26.overview: In a world shattered by a devastating cataclysm, a young Earthbender discovers she's the new Avatar after Korra. But in this dangerous era, that title marks her as humanity's destroyer, not its savior. Hunted by both human and spirit enemies, she and her long-lost twin must uncover their mysterious origins and save the Seven Havens before civilization's last strongholds collapse.

2026-11-26.title: Take Charge of My Heart
2026-11-26.overview: A corporate heir with an artificial heart meets a woman who's literally electric. They strike a deal that makes his heart beat — in more ways than one.

2026-11-26.title: Eternally Yours
2026-11-26.overview: Charles and Liz are a charming, married 500-year-old vampire couple whose relationship has survived centuries because, as vampires, divorce isn’t exactly an option. Together, they navigate modern society and their daughter dating a human.

2026-11-26.title: Carrie
2026-11-26.overview: After her father's sudden, untimely death thrusts her into the unforgiving ecosystem of public high school, Carrie is forced to navigate a viral bullying scandal that tears through her community, the relentless pressure and casual cruelty of the social‑media age, and the awakening of mysterious telekinetic powers that rise alongside her adolescence.

2026-11-26.title: GET JIRO
2026-11-26.overview: In a post-apocalyptic, near-future Los Angeles where culinary culture reigns supreme, the world's most powerful figures are chefs, and food is both currency and a demarcation of class, the mysterious sushi chef Jiro sets out on a quest for vengeance.

2026-11-26.title: Coven Academy
2026-11-26.overview: A coven protects their magic school from a dark fate.

2026-11-26.title: LEGO ONE PIECE
2026-11-26.overview: The Straw Hats hit the high seas in a two-part LEGO special! Join Luffy, Nami, Usopp and the crew on their epic journey, fully reimagined brick by brick.

2026-11-26.title: My Sad Dead
2026-11-26.overview: A reclusive doctor with supernatural abilities faces a disruption when her young niece visits, bringing a different and more intense approach to their shared gift of communicating with spirits.

2026-11-26.title: Golden Axe
2026-11-26.overview: Legendary warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead reunite to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder, who just won't seem to stay dead. Their quest is complicated by Hampton Squib, an inexperienced and wildly underprepared adventurer whose dream of heroism far exceeds his abilities. Forced to work together despite their flaws, they must find a way to stop Death Adder once and for all.

2026-11-26.title: Khom Khlang
2026-11-26.overview: A Bangkok police officer hunting a supernatural human trafficking kingpin teams up with a mysterious spiritual master. As they uncover dark magic and ancient rituals, they discover they are fated soulmates.

2026-11-26.title: The Last Oath
2026-11-26.overview: Immune to a deadly zombie virus, a student forms a forbidden bond with the agent sent to hunt him as they battle corrupt pharmaceutical giants.

2026-11-26.title: NOUR
2026-11-26.overview: When bizarre fires expose a multi-generational curse, two police officers uncover buried secrets while love and corruption threaten to consume them.

2026-11-26.title: Pull Strings
2026-11-26.overview: Li Changshou, a terminally ill patient in his previous life, is reborn into the Primordial World as a low-level Qi cultivator who cherishes life and avoids all karmic entanglements. Determined to dodge the great calamity foretold by the Heavenly Dao, he adopts the "Way of Steady" — his ultimate goal being to secure a humble post in the Heavenly Court and survive quietly. He operates with extreme caution: when still, he's as steady as an old dog; when he moves, he shakes the heavens. He firmly believes the era of bloodshed is over — better to trick than to kill, better to stay single than to fall in love. Yet enemies and beauties keep surging toward him like tides. Before he knows it, he becomes a mastermind pulling strings behind the scenes, entangled in power plays among multiple factions, orchestrating the "Dragon Clan's ascent to Heaven" — and even the great calamity itself accelerates toward him…

2026-11-26.title: Lanterns
2026-11-26.overview: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

2026-11-26.title: Unlucky Bae
2026-11-26.overview: After a drunken ritual goes wrong, Rin accidentally curses an innocent business student. To fix the mess, he stays close — only to fall in love.

2026-11-26.title: President Curtis
2026-11-26.overview: Follow the Commander-in-Chief and his eccentric staff as they tackle the kind of crises that Rick Sanchez could never be bothered with - from interdimensional diplomacy to paranormal investigations and unexplained phenomena.

2026-11-26.title: Stuart Fails to Save the Universe
2026-11-26.overview: After accidentally creating a new multiverse, comic book store owner Stuart Bloom must locate a quantum-interference device to restore reality.

2026-11-26.title: Spooky in Love
2026-11-26.overview: When a ghost-seeing heir and an ace prosecutor learn that a single touch makes them a strangely effective duo, they team up to crack unsolved murders.
